segments.name: Software Solutions
segments.description: Networking, security and monitoring software sold to organisations, typically as subscriptions.
segments.evidence: Our core offerings include SD-WAN, SASE, single stack cybersecurity ("Cybersecurity"), and network monitoring service ("NMS") software solutions, each of which is typically offered to our customers as a subscription service.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for perpetual software licenses, technical support and monitoring services, and project-based consulting.
revenueModel.evidence: Software product and license revenue is generated through the sale of perpetual licenses for our proprietary SD-WAN, SASE, NMS, and cybersecurity software, including delivery of the related network server hardware components, where applicable.
